pay_detail: Tuition $750 plus a $100 registration fee credited to tuition. Optional youth housing with meals is $500 (2026 prices).
name: Summer Brass Academy (Jacobs School of Music)
org: Jacobs Academy, Jacobs School of Music, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A week of brass group coaching, master classes and topic classes with Jacobs brass faculty. There are also faculty concerts. For trumpet, trombone, bass trombone, horn and tuba.
who_can_apply: High school age (pre-college) and undergraduate brass players. The page gives no exact age range. You send a placement recording for ensemble placement.
deadline_text: 2026 registration, placement recording and payment were due May 15, 2026. Youth forms were due May 29, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up online and pay the $100 fee and tuition. Also upload a placement recording to the Jacobs audition portal.
